title: Konieczny Zygmunt
name: Konieczny Zygmunt
description: composer, pianist and arranger; b. 3rd January 1937 in Kraków. In 1956-62 he studied composition with Stanisław Wiechowicz at the State Higher School of Music in Kraków. In the years 1959-67 he collaborated with "Piwnica pod Baranami" as pianist, accompanist, and composer. At that time he wrote songs for leading artists of the literary cabaret, including Mieczysław Święcicki and Ewa Demarczyk. Among his best-known pieces are the immensely popular Karuzela z Madonnami ( Carousel with Madonnas ) and Taki pejzaż ( A Landscape Like This ), which won prizes of the Opole Song Festival in 1963, Czarne anioły ( Black Angels ) (special awards of the Opole Song Festival and the Sopot Song Festival in 1963), Grande valse brillante (2nd prize of the Sopot Song Festival in 1964). In 1991 he received the Minister of Culture and Art award for his composition achievements. As a composer of theatre music he made his debut in 1959 having written music for Arthur Miller's View form the Bridge (dir. by Jerzy Goliński, Juliusz Słowacki Theatre in Kraków). Since that time he has collaborated with Kraków-based theatres (Juliusz Słowacki Theatre, Helena Modrzejewska Old Theatre, Rapsodyczny Theatre, Ludowy Theatre, Groteska Mask and Puppet Theatre, STU Theatre), and institutions across Poland, including Wybrzeże Theatre in Gdańsk, Dramatyczny Theatre in Warsaw, National Theatre in Warsaw, Ludwik Solski Theatre in Tarnów, Studio Theatre in Warsaw, Stefan Jaracz Theatre in Łódź, New Theatre in Poznań, Juliusz Osterwa Theatre in Lublin, Polski Theatre in Wrocław, Współczesny Theatre in Warsaw, Music Theatre – Wrocław Operetta, Baltic Drama Theatre in Koszalin. In 2011-12 he wrote music for Roma Music Theatre in Warsaw, Helena Modrzejewska Old Theatre in Kraków, Stanisław Wyspiański Silesian Theatre in Katowice, and Współczesny Theatre in Warsaw. He collaborated with prominent directors, namely: Konrad Swinarski ( A Midsummer Night's Dream , Dziady / Forefathers' Eve , Wyzwolenie / Liberation ), Andrzej Wajda ( Biesy / Demons , Noc listopadowa / November Night , Klątwa / Curse ), Jerzy Jarocki ( Wiśniowy sad / A Cherry Orchard , Portret / Portrait , Mewa / The Seagull ), Andrzej Łapicki (Portret Doriana Graya/ The Picture of Dorian Gray , Dwa teatry / Two Theatres ), Tadeusz Łomnicki ( Do piachu… / Dead and Buried , Affabulazione ), Adam Hanuszkiewicz ( Leśmian ), Mikołaj Grabowski ( Opis obyczajów , Pan Tadeusz czyli Ostatni Zajazd na Litwie / Sir Thaddeus, or the Last Lithuanian Foray ), or Maciej Englert ( Mistrz i Małgorzata / The Master and Margarita , Martwe dusze / Dead Souls , Mieszczanin szlachcicem / The Bourgeois Gentleman , Wniebowstąpienie / Ascension , Czarowna noc / Enchanted Night , Proces / The Trial , Hamlet ). The artist composed scores for over a hundred of feature, TV and short films. He collaborated on many occasions with such directors as Andrzej Wajda ( Krajobraz po bitwie , Biesy ), Antoni Krauze ( Palec boży , Podróż do Arabii ), Wojciech Marczewski ( Zmory , Klucznik , Ucieczka z kina Wolność ), Tadeusz Konwicki ( Jak daleko stąd jak blisko , Dolina Issy , Lawa ), Andrzej Barański ( Lucyna , Tabu ), Stanisław Różewicz ( Opadły liście z drzew , Śmieszny staruszek ), Jan Jakub Kolski ( Pogrzeb kartofla , Jańcio Wodnik , Grający z talerza , Historia kina w Popielawach , Pornografia , Jasminum ), Małgorzata Szumowska ( Szczęśliwy człowiek ), Maciej Wojtyszko ( Święty interes ). Zygmunt Konieczny received the City of Kraków Award (1974, 2007), Award of the Chairman of the 1st Degree Radio and Television Committee for his work for Polish Radio and Television (1978), Governor of the Kraków Province Award (1996), and many individual awards for his film scores. He also received the Officer's Cross of the Order of Polonia Restituta (1998) and the Commander's Cross of the Order of Polonia Restituta for "outstanding contribution to Polish culture and artistic and creative achievements" (2012). January 2013 (Anna Iwanicka-Nijakowska) Artist's website: www.zygmuntkonieczny.art.pl
